record.question: Codes specify lower bond resistance for the top reinforcement in beam because:
options: Top reinforcement in a beam is more important and hence lower bond resistance is given for having longer development length.
There is a possibility of air trapped beneath the upper reinforcement and thereby weakening the bond.
The higher part of concrete in a beam have lower strength.
The top part is exposed to air after casting so the concrete on the upper part is weaker.
